notes: Power plug: the SwitchBot Plug Mini replaces the Shelly. Pair it in Piano › Power plug › Find, tap it, and it clicks on and off; no Wi-Fi or SwitchBot app. The tablet switches it off at start, after every piece, and whenever it sees it on with nothing playing. New: Piano › Power use shows the watts now, the peaks and the kWh used. Keep an outlet timer as the backup: the plug has no timer of its own.
